# Operational canon (fixture)

<CAMPAIGN_ID> is a placeholder setting used only by the harness test suite.

- <PC_ID> is the player character.
- <NPC_A> and <NPC_B> are the two named non-player characters.
- <LOCATION_A> is where the fixture opens; <LOCATION_B> is reachable from it.
- <GROUP_A> is the organization <NPC_A> belongs to.

## Standing rules
- Nothing here names a real place, person, period or genre.
